query: SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE state IN ('pending','running')) AS "depth!",count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='failed') AS "failures!",COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM clock_timestamp()-min(run_at) FILTER(WHERE state='pending' AND run_at<clock_timestamp())),0)::bigint AS "overdue_seconds!",(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND wait_event_type='Lock') AS "lock_waiters!" FROM jobs
